shape_hint: A plain straight fully-threaded rod (all-thread) used vertically to hang pipes, trays or ducts from a ceiling; no head, ends cut square or chamfered, usually zinc plated; threaded into hanger clamps, clevises, beam clamps or rod couplings with hex nuts.

role_map.d_nom: nominal rod diameter, inch fraction (Korean 부 = 1/8 in)

notes: Korean hanger rods are called 3부 (3/8), 4부 (1/2), 5부 (5/8), 6부 (3/4), 7부(7/8), 8부 (1) and are sold as 'W' (Whitworth) or UNC thread depending on the supplier; only UNC is verified here. BSW pitches are not identical to UNC at every size; ask the supplier or verify before publishing a 'W' table. Hanger rod load ratings (MSS SP-58/ASME B31.1) have only one public table found, so loads are not published.

verification.checks_done: Re-downloaded all 6 URLs live (HTTP 200). 9 rows (3/8..1-1/2) x 4 value columns (tpi, d2, Ar, As). tpi: efunda, threadspec, fbc, aptp, mechc agree on all 9 rows; d2: efunda, threadspec, fbc, aptp agree on all 9 (4 clusters); Ar ('Minor Dia Area'/'Minor Area'/'Section at Minor Dia.'): efunda, fbc, aptp, mechc agree on all 9 (4 clusters); As: all 5 agree on all 9. 0 disagreements. Physical: d2 = D - 0.649519/tpi within 5e-5; Ar = pi/4 (D - 1.299038/tpi)^2 within 0.09 %; As within 0.14 % of pi/4 (D - 0.9743/tpi)^2; Ar < As < pi/4 D^2 on every row; tpi non-increasing 16..6.
problems: UNC only. The family's governing standard in the catalog is BS 84 (Whitworth 55 deg) first, ASME B1.1 second; Korean hanger bolts (3-bu/4-bu/5-bu) are often W-thread, and BSW 1/2 is 12 tpi vs UNC 13, so the 1/2 row (tpi 13, d2 0.45) is wrong for a W rod. Publish strictly as 'UNC' (the column labels already say UNC) and do not present it as the BS 84 table.

Row selection (3/8..1-1/2 = hanger sizes) comes from a single page (Engineering ToolBox pipe-size/rod table); every cell is verified, but the 'which sizes are hanger rods' claim has one source. 1-1/8 is a hanger size there but rarely stocked.
Table is a pure subset of rod-in's UNC table plus the Ar column; nothing hanger-specific (no load ratings: only one source).
Ar role read from headers ('Minor Dia Area'/'Minor Area'/'Section at Minor Dia.'), consistent with the basic external minor diameter (D - 1.299/tpi).

standard_full: ASME B1.1 UNC (hanger rod sizes 3/8-1-1/2); BS 84 Whitworth variant NOT verified
